{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id rows, keeping the one with highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_df = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

mean_biomarker_severe"}
